name: @cmodjs/plint
description: Lints Claude Code Prompts against static and agentic rules.

scripts.build: for machine in ${CMOD_MACHINES:-darwin-arm64 darwin-x64 linux-arm64 linux-x64}; do bun build --compile --minify --target=bun-$machine src/main.ts --outfile dist/plint-$machine || exit 1; done
